newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Rouble dips as non-residents take T-bill profits.
newsitem.headline: Rouble dips as non-residents take T-bill profits.

text.p: The rouble eased on Thursday as non-residents covered forward positions to take profits on Treasury bills but the decline was slowed by demand for roubles from gas monopoly Gazprom to pay off tax arrears, dealers said.
roubles/dollar May 15 midday May 15 early May 14 close

"Foreigners are seeking dollars to close their forward contracts, struck mainly for 15th of the month. But the bullish trend did not last long," Aljba Alliance Bank chief dealer Dmitry Slobodnik said.
Dealers said a major bank may have sold $300-500 million for Gazprom for tomorrow settlement at 5,762 roubles per dollar.
They added Gazprom has been seen selling dollars actively since Tuesday to pay taxes under governmental pressure.
But the client buying failed to push up the rouble.
"The central bank has bought many dollars recently, injecting roubles into the market and increasing therefore their market volume," one dealer said.
